title: The Storehouse Reckoning

roles.name: Senior Scribe
roles.interest: Wants a reliable record that can be checked and reused; approves the apprentice's work.
roles.required_interaction: Reviews the proposed register and rules on adoption.

roles.name: Storehouse Steward
roles.interest: Needs to know what is available for allocation and what remains held or disputed.
roles.required_interaction: Explains how stock status affects allocations and tests whether the register can be used.

roles.name: Receiving Official
roles.interest: Wants arrival and condition recorded accurately; witnessed intake but cannot establish later cause.
roles.required_interaction: Explains the intake procedure and the limits of the initial inspection.

roles.name: Carrier Foreman
roles.interest: Wants the dispatched quantity and completed delivery recognized; disputes unsupported claims that the carrier caused later damage.
roles.required_interaction: Supplies dispatch-side corroboration and responds to the player's proposed finding.

roles.name: Brewing-House Representative
roles.interest: Needs an accurate account of the grain issued and wants the operation credited for what it actually received.
roles.required_interaction: Confirms the issue and tests whether the register identifies recipient and authority correctly.

timeline.label: 30 measures issued to brewing house (E-05)
timeline.notes: GDD v1.2 does not say whether the issue happened before or after the leak report.

timeline.label: Roof leak reported (E-06)
timeline.notes: Order relative to T-issue is undecided; it decides whether any issued grain could have been affected.

evidence.establishes: The storehouse began the period with 24 usable standard institutional measures.
60 measures were dispatched to the storehouse by the sending institution under a named dispatch authority.
60 measures were physically unloaded and counted at intake.

evidence.source: Initial receiving inspection tally (sealed intake record)
evidence.establishes: At intake, 56 measures were classified as usable and 4 as damp and held separately.
30 usable measures were authorized and issued to the brewing-house operation; the representative confirms receipt.
A roof leak was reported after intake but before the later recount.
evidence.limits: Does not establish when moisture spread or who was responsible for the roof condition.

evidence.establishes: 47 measures are still usable and 7 are now damp and held. Since intake, 30 usable measures were issued and 3 more measures changed from usable to held. Remaining physical stock is 54.
5 of the 7 held measures have dried and are usable; 2 remain held.
The Steward authorizes the 5 dried measures to return to usable stock.
No reliable departure-condition or route inspection establishes where the 2-measure discrepancy arose.
evidence.limits: Does not support blaming the carrier or anyone else.

actions.label: Retrieve and examine the prior closing-balance tablet
Consult the Carrier Foreman about the dispatch record
actions.notes: Reconciliation: GDD section 7.3 prices E-02 retrieval at 1 AP via the Foreman; Stage A also lists a separate 'compare E-03 with E-02' action and a 'consult Foreman' action. Treated here as one retrieval (A-02) plus one comparison (A-03).

actions.label: Examine the arrival tally and compare it with the dispatch tablet
Retrieve the sealed intake record from the Receiving Official
Conduct the physical recount with the Steward
actions.notes: Prerequisite A-04 is proposed: the recount only exposes a discrepancy if the player already holds the intake record.

actions.label: Ask the Steward for custody and maintenance notes
actions.notes: GDD: not needed to finish Stage A, but needed to cite the roof leak (accepted outcome O-A05). Confirm whether full adoption really requires it.

actions.label: Confirm the issue with the Brewing-House Representative
Select and configure one register design
Draft opening balance, receipt, intake condition, later status change and issue entries
Add source references and unresolved-cause notation
Ask the Senior Scribe to review the proposed fields
Retrieve the evidence for Test C-1 (held-stock release)
Enter Test C-1 in the proposed register
Audit the Test C-1 entry
Retrieve the evidence for Test C-2 (short delivery)
Enter Test C-2 in the proposed register
Audit the Test C-2 entry
Consult the relevant institutional reader about an ambiguity
Run the final audit against all completed test cases
Ask the Steward and Senior Scribe to review the register
actions.notes: GDD v1.2 Day 4 merges this and D-04 into one '(1)' line; the Stage D list prices them separately.

actions.label: Revise fields, entries or cross-references (one pass)
Present the register for institutional approval

stages.name: Investigate the discrepancy
stages.objective: Determine why the current stock condition differs from the intake record and what the evidence can and cannot prove.
stages.deliverable: A structured finding separating dispatch, physical receipt, intake condition, later condition, issue and current balance; the player identifies that three measures changed status rather than disappeared.

stages.name: Design the register
stages.objective: Choose a record structure that preserves provenance and can represent future stock movements.
stages.deliverable: A draft register preserving the two distinct condition snapshots and the movement between them.

stages.name: Test the register against unseen transactions
stages.objective: Prove the structure works beyond the example used to create it.
stages.deliverable: Both test transactions entered and passed.

stages.name: Audit, revise and obtain adoption
stages.objective: Audit the initial case and test results, correct deficiencies and secure a documented institutional decision.
stages.deliverable: A tested register and a recorded decision: adopt, adopt provisionally with a required modification, or decline pending revision.

register_designs.label: Compact balance register
register_designs.strength: Fast to enter; records opening balance, receipt, usable/held totals, issue and closing balance.
register_designs.limitation: Status changes and later releases need explanatory notes or cross-references; movement history is easy to lose.

register_designs.label: Movement ledger
register_designs.strength: Each movement or status change is a dated, sourced line with quantity, status, authority, location and recorder.
register_designs.limitation: Takes longer to establish and maintain; requires more careful entry.

tests.label: Release of held stock
tests.capability: Record a status transfer without inventing a new receipt.
must_not: record only a new usable balance without the transfer history

tests.label: Short delivery
tests.capability: Keep dispatch quantity distinct from physical receipt.

invariants.description: Intake condition accounts for every unloaded measure.
Closing stock = opening + receipt - issue, split into usable and held.
Held stock grew only by status change.
Test C-1 moves stock between statuses without changing the total.
Test C-2 discrepancy equals dispatch minus receipt.
The 30-measure issue went to the brewing-house operation under the supplied authority, not to the steward.
The evidence establishes a roof leak was reported but not who caused the damp condition or when each measure became damp.

responsibility_questions.question: Who caused the three measures to change from usable to held?
Where did the 2-measure shortfall in the second delivery arise?

outcomes.description: Preserves both the intake condition (56/4) and the later recount (47/7).
Records the three-measure status change as a change in condition, not a disappearance or new receipt.
Records the completed issue to the brewing-house operation with its authority and provenance.
Calculates closing usable stock as 47 and held stock as 7.
Records the roof leak as reported context while leaving individual responsibility unresolved.
Passes every required unseen transaction test (adoption.tests_required = all) and records each test's evidence and source.
Treats the 3-measure status change as a loss without evidence.
outcomes.correction_path: Re-read E-07: stock is 54 physical measures; the three moved from usable to held.

outcomes.description: Overwrites the intake record instead of keeping the later recount as a separate event.
outcomes.correction_path: Restore the intake snapshot and record the recount as a later dated event.

outcomes.description: Records the 7 held measures as usable.
outcomes.correction_path: Reclassify 7 as held pending assessment; usable closing balance is 47.

outcomes.description: Treats a held-to-usable release as a new receipt.
outcomes.correction_path: Record a status transfer of 5; total physical stock is unchanged.

outcomes.description: Records 20 dispatched as 20 received when the count is 18.
outcomes.correction_path: Record 20 dispatched, 18 received and a 2-measure discrepancy pending inquiry.

outcomes.description: Assigns blame to the carrier, receiving official or steward without supporting evidence.
outcomes.correction_path: State that the evidence does not establish cause, citing the limiting source.

outcomes.description: Treats the steward as the recipient of the brewing-house issue.
outcomes.correction_path: Correct the recipient to the brewing-house operation under the supplied authority.

outcomes.description: Omits the source or authority for a material transaction.
outcomes.correction_path: Add evidence references and the authority; adoption may be provisional until corrected.

outcomes.description: Reports a closing usable balance other than 47 or a held balance other than 7.

consequences.effect: Later storehouse dossiers expose status changes, dispatch/receipt differences, issue and balance as separate traceable events.
Later status changes and discrepancies need linked notes; future dossiers include those notes and may cost extra AP to reconcile.
The register is used with a named missing field or cross-reference rule; the deficiency appears in later dossiers until corrected.
The Work stays active; the player revises and retests at the stated AP cost. No single failure soft-locks the Work.

rewards.rule: Allocated with the other Era I required Works; must satisfy the GDD section 4.4 progression invariant.

reconciliation_notes: E-02 retrieval is modelled once (A-02, Carrier Foreman, 1 AP). GDD section 7.3 and the Stage A table price it differently.
The Day 1 illustrative path lists a 'Steward discussion (1)' that is not an action in any stage table; it has no action here.
D-02 (review) and D-04 (present) are separate 1 AP actions. The Day 4 path merges them into one '(1)' line.
GDD section 7.6 accepted outcomes say 'at least one unseen transaction test'; Stage C says both are required. This data uses tests_required = all.
E-06 is not required to finish Stage A but is needed to cite the roof leak (O-A05). A-06 is therefore required for full adoption only; confirm this intent.
The extra_ap values on the compact register are proposed placeholders; the GDD says only that notes or supplemental records are needed.
